label: Artificial Analysis · τ²-Bench Telecom (via BenchLM mirror)
note: Multi-turn tool calling against a simulated user and policy (the closest public measure of a manager/worker holding a tool loop together). Artificial Analysis blocks automated fetches, so this is read from BenchLM, which republishes AA rows labelled with their setup; ONLY rows labelled "AA" are used, so every number shares one harness. Vendor-published telecom rows (GPT-5.4/5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro) use other setups and are excluded. Agentic only, fitted onto Terminal-Bench 2.1. It covers the older models the Vals boards never ran, which is where it earns its place: GPT-4o, GPT-4.1 and Gemini 2.x hold a tool loop together far worse than their old seed scores claimed. Where AA lists a model twice the default (non-thinking) row is used.
